# On This Day

> A comprehensive historical reference site documenting notable events, births, deaths, and cultural milestones that occurred on any given date throughout history.

On This Day provides daily historical content organized by category—from world events and famous births to sports achievements, film premieres, and music milestones. Users can explore history chronologically through interactive calendars, browse by country or cultural domain, or test their knowledge with weekly quizzes.

## Key Topics

- Historical events
- Famous births
- Notable deaths
- Sports history
- Music history
- Film and TV history
- American history
- British history
- French history
- World history
- Celebrity birthdays
- Historical figures
- Timeline
- Daily reference
- Cultural events

## Today's Historical Content

- [Today in History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/events.php): Historical events from today featuring figures like Heraclius and Charles Martel
- [Today's Famous Birthdays - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/birthdays.php): Famous people born today including historical figures from Song Dynasty era
- [Celebrity Birthdays Today - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/celebrity-birthdays.php): Celebrity birthdays today featuring musicians, actors and sports stars
- [Who Died Today in History? - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/deaths.php): Notable deaths today including Benedict of Nursia and Polish royalty
- [Today's Famous Wedding Anniversaries - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/weddings-divorces.php): Famous wedding anniversaries and divorces including Grant family White House events
- [Today in History Fun Facts - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/fun-facts.php): Fun historical facts including Beethoven and Napoleonic Code events

## Regional and National History

- [Today in American History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/american-history.php): US history events, births and deaths today from New Orleans to Massachusetts
- [Today in British History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/british-history.php): British history featuring monarchs Henry V, King James I and Queen Anne
- [Today in French History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/french-history.php): French history featuring Napoleonic Code and playwright Jean Anouilh
- [Today in German History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/german-history.php): German history from Black Death era to modern times in Erfurt and beyond
- [Today in Indian History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/indian-history.php): Indian history featuring cricketers Sunil Gavaskar and leaders like Akbar
- [Today in Canadian History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/today/canadian-history.php): Canadian history including hockey legend Frank Mahovlich and Rick Hansen

## Culture, Entertainment & Sports

- [Today in Sports History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/sport): Sports history covering boxing, horse racing, cricket and cycling events
- [Today in Music History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/music): Music history featuring Beethoven and Alan Freed's Moondog Coronation Ball
- [Today in Movie and TV History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/film-tv): Film and TV history including Hitchcock's Rebecca and Laurence Olivier

## Historical Reference & Navigation

- [Calendar of Days in History - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/calendar.php): Interactive calendar to browse historical events, births and deaths by date
- [Dates in History by Year - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/dates-by-year.php): Chronological index of historical dates organized by year from ancient history
- [List of Famous People and Historical Figures - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/famous-people.php): Directory of notable figures including Napoleon, Federer and Christopher Columbus
- [What Happened on March 20 - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/day/march/20): March 20 history featuring Volta, Napoleon and Royal Society of London events

## Interactive Features

- [Weekly History Quiz for March 16 - 22 - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/quiz/march/16-22): Interactive weekly history quiz covering Knossos, Napoleon, and Uncle Tom's Cabin
